name: FINNS NYE Festival 2026
venue: FINNS Beach Club, Jl. Pantai Berawa
price_text: IDR 3,600,000 two-day GA, second release (about $290 AUD); VIP IDR 10,000,000
time: 30–31 Dec; NYE doors 2:00pm – 2:00am (no entry after midnight)
includes: Two-day pass for 30 and 31 December (single-day tickets not sold)
Announced so far: Major Lazer Soundsystem and CYRIL (30 Dec), The Temper Trap DJ set (31 Dec), more TBA
Beach party, pools and multiple bars
VIP: priority entry, welcome drink, canapés and table service
blurb: Bali's biggest NYE ticket, now a two-day beach festival on Berawa Beach. It sells out every year, so book the release you can get.

name: Atlas Beach Club NYE with Quavo
venue: Atlas Beach Fest, Jl. Pantai Berawa
price_text: From IDR 1,500,000 GA, early bird (about $120 AUD); daybeds and sofas extra
includes: Huge beachfront super club with multiple pools
DJs through the afternoon and night
Daybed and sofa packages (mostly F&B credit)
blurb: One of the world's largest beach clubs goes big for NYE 2026 with a live set from Quavo on Berawa Beach.

name: La Brisa New Year's Eve
price_text: TBA. 2026 tickets not yet published
includes: Driftwood beach club right on Echo Beach
blurb: The boho, salvaged-timber beach club at Echo Beach throws one of Canggu's most photogenic NYE parties. 2026 details to come.

name: Café del Mar Bali NYE
venue: Café del Mar Bali, Batu Bolong
price_text: TBA. 2025 headliner was Dash Berlin
includes: Mediterranean-style beachfront club with a large pool
blurb: Ibiza's famous sunset brand on Batu Bolong Beach, with a headline DJ for the countdown. 2026 lineup not yet announced.

name: COMO Uma Canggu NYE Dinner
venue: COMO Beach Club, COMO Uma Canggu
price_text: IDR 1,000,000++ dinner only (about $80 AUD); IDR 1,800,000++ with drinks (2025 price, 2026 TBC)
blurb: A dressed-up, Bollywood-meets-Bali dinner at COMO's beach club, a calmer alternative to the Berawa mega parties.

name: Holiday Inn Canggu Festive NYE Buffet
venue: Roomah Restaurant, Holiday Inn Resort Bali Canggu
price_text: IDR 455,000++ early booking (about $35 AUD); kids under 12 eat free (2025 price, 2026 TBC)
includes: Sushi and oyster bar, carving station
Children under 12 eat free with parents
Rooftop infinity-pool bar countdown with ocean views
blurb: Excellent-value family buffet in Canggu, with kids eating free and a rooftop countdown afterwards.

name: Potato Head New Year's Eve
price_text: TBA. 2025 tickets sold in tiers via Potato Head
includes: Day-to-night beach party with an extended dancefloor
Leftfield house and disco DJ lineup (2025: Job Jobse, Shanti Celeste, Leon Vynehall)
blurb: Seminyak's creative beach club does NYE with a serious DJ lineup and an after-party at its own disco, Klymax.

name: KU DE TA New Year's Eve
venue: KU DE TA, Jl. Kayu Aya 9
price_text: TBA. Packages usually released in Q4
includes: Beachfront party with live acts and resident DJs
blurb: The original Seminyak beach club, with a dinner-then-dance NYE right on the sand. 2026 packages not yet published.

name: W Bali Seminyak NYE Party
venue: WET Deck & W Lounge, W Bali Seminyak
price_text: Early bird IDR 700,000 incl IDR 300,000 F&B credit (about $55 AUD); door IDR 1,700,000; dinners from IDR 3,800,000++ (2025 prices, 2026 TBC)
includes: Headline house DJ (2025: David Penn) plus residents
Early-bird ticket includes IDR 300,000 food and drink credit
Separate NYE dinner at Starfish Bloo and FIRE
blurb: W's beachfront pool deck turns into a house-music party for the countdown, with a sit-down dinner option first.

name: The Oberoi Beach Resort NYE Gala Dinner
venue: Kura Kura, The Oberoi Beach Resort, Bali
price_text: IDR 2,500,000++ vegetarian; IDR 3,500,000++ Western set (about $200 AUD to about $280 AUD) (2025 prices, 2026 TBC)
blurb: A classic, elegant beachfront gala at one of Seminyak's oldest resorts, which has hosted NYE for over four decades.

name: Hotel Indigo Seminyak NYE Dinner
venue: SugarSand & Makase, Hotel Indigo Bali Seminyak Beach
price_text: IDR 1,300,000++ (about $105 AUD); kids 6–11 half price (2025 price, 2026 TBC)
includes: Five-course beachfront dinner at SugarSand, or international buffet at Makase
Live DJ or band, hula and fire dance
blurb: Two good-value NYE dinners on Seminyak Beach with half-price kids, ideal for families staying in town.

name: Motel Mexicola NYE
price_text: TBA. 2025 tickets sold via Megatix
includes: Five hours of unlimited tacos, cocktails, beer and wine
DJs and Mexicola's famous fiesta atmosphere
Separate parties at the Seminyak, Canggu and Uluwatu venues
blurb: Five hours of free-flow tacos and margaritas, then a loud countdown. One of Bali's most fun-for-the-price NYE nights.

name: Holiday Inn Baruna 'Sparkling Treasure' NYE
venue: Holiday Inn Resort Baruna Bali, Tuban
price_text: IDR 1,500,000 (about $120 AUD); 30% off early booking (2025 price, 2026 TBC)
includes: Countdown on the beachfront lawn with DJ, games and treasure hunts
blurb: A playful pirate-themed dinner and beachfront countdown near the airport. Easy for families and late arrivals.

name: Padma Resort Legian NYE Countdown
price_text: Poolside countdown IDR 100,000 nett incl a drink (about $10 AUD); buffet dinner IDR 2,000,000+ (2025 prices, 2026 TBC)
includes: Infinity poolside countdown with live DJ, band and dance performances
One cocktail or small Bintang included
International buffet dinner at DONBIU (separate ticket)
blurb: One of the cheapest ways to welcome the new year in Legian: a poolside party for about the price of two drinks.

name: Savaya NYE: Carl Cox, Nic Fanciulli & Prospa
venue: Savaya Bali, Jl. Belimbing Sari, Pecatu
price_text: IDR 5,000,000 GA (about $400 AUD); GA currently listed as sold out, tables by enquiry
includes: Carl Cox b2b Nic Fanciulli sunrise set (from 3am)
Prospa (midnight – 3am), plus Sara Siu and Sarabi
Clifftop superclub above the Indian Ocean
blurb: Bali's most famous clifftop club brings Carl Cox to play into the first sunrise of 2027. Strictly 21+.

name: Sundays Beach Club NYE
price_text: Beach club pass about IDR 1,500,000 (about $120 AUD); early-bird beds on sale
includes: Live musicians, fire dancers and water drums
Early-bird wood-deck and sand-deck king and queen beds
blurb: An all-white beach party in a hidden cove below the Ungasan cliffs, with fire dancers and fireworks over the water.

name: White Rock Beach Club NYE 2026
venue: White Rock Beach Club, Melasti Beach
price_text: From IDR 182,000 standing (about $15 AUD); check current release
includes: Eight DJ sets plus live sax and percussion
blurb: A big-value Melasti Beach party: a full afternoon-to-3am lineup for less than the cost of a dinner elsewhere.

name: Single Fin NYE
price_text: Free entry before 9pm, paid after (2025 format, 2026 TBC)
includes: Clifftop surf bar above Uluwatu's famous break
blurb: The legendary surfers' bar on the Uluwatu cliffs. Get in early and free, and catch the last sunset of the year.

name: Ulu Cliffhouse NYE
price_text: Free guestlist until 8pm; tickets from IDR 200,000 early bird (about $15 AUD) (2025 prices, 2026 TBC)
includes: Fireworks over the ocean at midnight
blurb: A clifftop pool club with a party crowd, fire dancers and fireworks over the ocean, at a fraction of Savaya prices.

name: El Kabron NYE
price_text: TBA. 2025 headliner was Aaron Hibell
time: Afternoon into night; arrive before sunset
includes: Spanish clifftop restaurant and pool club
Headline DJ set (2025: Aaron Hibell, floral theme)
blurb: Sunset paella and cava on the cliffs, then a headline DJ and fireworks over the ocean. 2026 details TBA.

name: Hatch Uluwatu NYE
price_text: TBA. Sells out most years
includes: Hip-hop blended with tech house, techno and trance
blurb: Uluwatu's party nightclub, known for big production and a hip-hop-meets-techno crowd. Tickets go fast.

name: Bvlgari Resort Bali: Evening Under the Stars
price_text: IDR 8,000,000++ (about $640 AUD); Il Ristorante seven-course with wine IDR 10,000,000++ (2025 prices, 2026 TBC)
includes: Alternative: seven-course Italian menu by Niko Romito with wine pairing
blurb: The island's most exclusive NYE table, 160 metres above the ocean at Bvlgari's clifftop resort.

name: Six Senses Uluwatu NYE Dinners
venue: Rocka & Watu Steakhouse, Six Senses Uluwatu
price_text: Rocka from IDR 2,300,000++ (about $185 AUD); Watu jazz and champagne from IDR 4,600,000++ (2025 prices, 2026 TBC)
includes: Rocka Final Feast: wood-fired roasts, Jimbaran lobster and Japanese stations
Watu Steakhouse: oysters, lobster ravioli, wagyu and free-flow champagne with live jazz
Countdown with lasers, fire dance and midnight toasts
blurb: Two clifftop dinners to choose from, then a countdown with fire dance and lasers above the Indian Ocean.

name: Jumeirah Bali NYE at Akasa
price_text: Buffet IDR 1,950,000++ (kids 5–11 IDR 975,000++); Akasa set menu IDR 2,600,000++ (from about $155 AUD) (2025 prices, 2026 TBC)
includes: Akasa set menu with sunset DJ, dance performance and live band
Family buffet at Segaran Dining Terrace
Fireworks over the Indian Ocean at midnight
blurb: A palace-style clifftop resort with a formal set menu at Akasa and a family buffet, both ending with ocean fireworks.

name: Karma Beach Seaside NYE
price_text: IDR 2,550,000++ non-members (about $205 AUD); kids 9 and under IDR 820,000++ (2025 prices, 2026 TBC)
includes: International buffet on a private beach
DJ sets, magician and kids' entertainment
Clifftop Venetian masquerade gala at di Mare as an alternative
blurb: A private-cove beach party with bonfires and a magician for the kids, reached by funicular from the clifftop.

name: Renaissance Uluwatu NYE: Nusantara Soirée
venue: Double Ikat & R Bar, Renaissance Bali Uluwatu
price_text: From about IDR 2,350,000++ (about $190 AUD) based on 2025; 2026 price TBC
includes: Indonesian-inspired set-menu dinner with free-flow drinks
'Reload the Beat' countdown at R Bar with a DJ
blurb: A free-flow archipelago dinner followed by a clifftop DJ countdown and fireworks. Confirmed for 2026.

name: Anantara Uluwatu NYE by the Cliff
price_text: Botol Biru IDR 1,550,000++; 360 Rooftop IDR 2,150,000++ (from about $125 AUD); 25% off advance booking (2025 prices, 2026 TBC)
includes: Four-course rooftop dinner or cliffside grill
Countdown by the cliff with live DJ
blurb: Rooftop or cliffside dinner, then a DJ countdown with fireworks at the edge of Impossibles Beach.

name: oneeighty° NYE Day Party
price_text: GA IDR 750,000++ incl IDR 300,000 credit (about $60 AUD) (2025 price, 2026 TBC)
includes: Glass-bottomed cliff-edge pool 162 metres above the sea
blurb: Spend the last afternoon of the year at Bali's most dramatic cliff-edge pool before moving on for the countdown.

name: AYANA Bali NYE Countdown & Dinners
venue: AYANA Resort Bali (Rock Bar, Center Core, KISIK)
price_text: Dinners from IDR 1,550,000++ (about $125 AUD); ballroom buffet IDR 2,500,000++ (kids 4–11 IDR 1,250,000++)
includes: Grand Countdown at AYANA Center Core with live music, DJs and major fireworks
Eight NYE dinners, from Karang (Indonesian) to KISIK lobster feast
blurb: A whole resort of NYE options: famous Rock Bar, eight dinners and one of Jimbaran's biggest fireworks shows. Confirmed for 2026.

name: Raffles Bali NYE Dinner at Loloan
price_text: IDR 6,500,000++ non-residents (about $520 AUD) (2025 price, 2026 TBC)
includes: Beachfront degustation with caviar, Boston lobster and foie gras
Half bottle of Louis Roederer Champagne per guest
blurb: An intimate, champagne-included degustation on a secluded Jimbaran beach. One of Bali's most luxurious NYE tables.

name: Sofitel La Nuit: Midnight in Paris
venue: Gamelan Grand Ballroom, Sofitel Bali Nusa Dua
price_text: Early bird IDR 4,500,000++ if paid by 31 Oct (about $360 AUD); then IDR 5,000,000++; teens IDR 2,500,000++
includes: Live performance by Lydia Rose, DJ, violinist and water drums
blurb: A Paris-themed free-flow gala with a live diva, fire dancers and fireworks. 2026 confirmed, with an early-bird deal until 31 October.

name: Courtyard Nusa Dua NYE Dinner & Countdown
venue: Courtyard by Marriott Bali Nusa Dua Resort
price_text: Countdown only IDR 800,000++ (about $65 AUD); dinner & countdown IDR 1,750,000++; kids 6–11 IDR 460,000++, under 6 free
blurb: Free-flow drinks and a DJ countdown at a family-friendly price, with kids under 12 free for the party. Confirmed for 2026.

name: The Apurva Kempinski Grandeur Gala
venue: Pendopo Lobby, The Apurva Kempinski Bali
price_text: Rooftop party IDR 1,500,000++ (about $120 AUD); gala IDR 4,888,000++ (kids 6–12 IDR 2,700,000++) (2025 prices, 2026 TBC)
includes: Gala dinner in the open-air Pendopo with performances from across Indonesia
L'Atelier rooftop party with free-flow cocktails, wine and canapés
Other dinners: Koral aquarium degustation, Izakaya by Oku, Reef Beach Club BBQ
blurb: A theatrical gala in one of Bali's grandest open-air lobbies, or free-flow cocktails on the rooftop.

name: The Westin Nusa Dua Celestial Tide NYE
venue: Mangupura Hall & IKAN, The Westin Resort Nusa Dua
price_text: IDR 2,300,000++ adults (about $185 AUD); kids IDR 1,150,000++ (2025 prices, 2026 TBC)
includes: Gala dinner with lobster and seafood
Beachside Bash with live DJ at IKAN
Indian NYE dinner at Ganesha Elite (from IDR 800,000++)
blurb: A big, family-friendly resort gala followed by a beach party for the grown-ups.

name: The Mulia New Year's Eve
price_text: Price on request. 2025 had two seatings; 2026 TBC
includes: International buffets plus Mediterranean, Chinese and Japanese specialty dinners
blurb: Nusa Dua's most lavish resort runs several NYE dinners and a glamorous countdown. Enquire early.

name: Andaz Bali NYE & Countdown Beach Party
price_text: IDR 2,900,000++ non-alcoholic (about $230 AUD); IDR 3,510,000++ with alcohol
includes: Access to four dining outlets in the village square
blurb: A roaming dinner across Andaz's Balinese village-style restaurants, then a beach countdown with fireworks.

name: Hyatt Regency Bali NYE Buffet & Countdown
price_text: IDR 2,500,000++ non-alcoholic (about $200 AUD); IDR 3,110,000++ with alcohol
blurb: A relaxed family buffet on Sanur Beach, ending with a beachfront countdown and fireworks.

name: Seaside Festive Symphony at The Meru Sanur
venue: Bali Beach Convention Center, The Meru Sanur
price_text: IDR 3,500,000++ (about $280 AUD) (2025 price, 2026 TBC)
includes: Orchestral concert (2025: Erwin Gutawa Orchestra and Indonesian guest stars)
blurb: A full orchestral NYE concert and buffet on Sanur's beachfront, popular with Indonesian and international families.

name: InterContinental Sanur Masquerade NYE
price_text: Buffet IDR 1,200,000++ (about $95 AUD) (2025 price, 2026 TBC)
includes: Masquerade-themed buffet with live music and saxophone
blurb: A masked buffet dinner, then a beach-pier countdown with fire dancers and fireworks.

name: Apéritif Ubud: Midnight Masquerade
price_text: TBA for 2026 (previous years about IDR 4,500,000 pp)
includes: Eight-course degustation by Chef Nic Vanderbeeken
Masquerade theme with live violin and piano
Cocktails and DJ at the bar through midnight
blurb: Ubud's grandest NYE dinner: eight courses, masks and live strings in a colonial-style dining room.

name: Embers Ubud: The Midnight Fire
price_text: IDR 950,000++ vegetarian (about $75 AUD); IDR 1,550,000++ Land & Sea; wine pairing from IDR 1,500,000++
includes: Wood-fired lobster or wagyu striploin mains
blurb: A wood-fired five-course dinner with live music into the new year, confirmed for 2026 at a fair Ubud price.

name: CasCades Ubud NYE Dinner & Kecak
price_text: About IDR 2,500,000 (about $200 AUD) (TBC)
includes: Valley views over the Petanu River
blurb: An Indonesian BBQ feast with a Kecak fire dance above the jungle valley. A cultural alternative to a beach party.

name: Copper Ubud Flame Festivities
venue: Copper Kitchen, Bar & Rooftop, Bisma Eight
price_text: TBA. 2025 BBQ was about IDR 950,000–1,450,000++
blurb: A smoky rooftop BBQ in central Ubud with a DJ for the countdown. Easy to walk to from most Ubud stays.

name: COMO Shambhala Traditional NYE Dinner
price_text: IDR 1,500,000++ adults (about $120 AUD); kids IDR 750,000++ (2025 prices, 2026 TBC)
includes: New Year's Day melukat water purification and offering class (extra)
blurb: A culturally rich, peaceful NYE in the jungle with Kecak dance. Perfect if you want to start 2027 with a blessing, not a hangover.
